reviews.x: I really feel this product is working. My eyelashes didn't touch my glasses and now they do. It's amazing.  I always thought my eyelashes were long. Now I know they are. Thanks!

reviews.t: This product actually works- especially on my eye brows!
reviews.x: I really love this lash serum! First, the packaging is absolutely chic. Who doesn't love this aethstetic? I love that the bottle is clear. The brush is longer than most serum brushes so you actually get enough product to feel like you put it on. It didn't burn, sting, or make my eyes red or itchy. I'm not one to hype a product before I use it for a longer amount of time but this is the real deal. My lashes are already a little longer and thicker after only a few days. My real concern has always

I really like how refreshing it is when I put it on first thing in the morning. It doesn't sting or make my eyelashes fall out like other products. Still waiting on the growth, but it's only been a few days!

I was blessed with thick, long, dark lashes all of my life but as I have gotten older (age 72) have found that blessing not so much. About 3 years ago I started using an expensive lash serums and it worked very well for me. Since retiring, last year, I got lax and stopped using it and it showed. Ordered this, didn't have great hopes because it was 1/4 of the price I usually pay but I was very pleasantly surprised and it is my new go-to.  I started using it twice a day, just over 3 weeks ago, and

Although the product  didn't work for me, the company did reach out and is trying to rectify the issue. I greatly appreciate a company that wants its customers happy and willing to go the extra mile for them. Thank you!

Zero results, brush is too thin hard to get product on it, I feel like I lost more lashes and brows using it and Undid the work from a previous serum I used, return window is closed I’m pretty upset about wasted money

I was skeptical when first trying the product, but it really surprised me! My lashes grew much faster than they ever have before. The applicator makes it easy to use, and it's quick to put on in the morning or right before bed. It even comes with a way to measure your lash growth! It also strengthens your lashes. My lashes use to fall out all the time, and I've seen less of that since using the product. I will buy this product again when mine runs out.
This truly works.  My lashes were super thin and pretty much non existent from extensions.
Doesn’t do anything for length but feels nice to put on
Sadly, had no growth after using for several weeks.

reviews.t: Did not work at all for me, irritated eyes at night
reviews.x: I was optimistic given all the great reviews— but this did not work at all for me. 5 weeks regular 2x daily, so thought I’d see by now. It irritated my eyes at night so I probably rubbed them and hurt healthy lashes in the process. Packaging was super cheap and made me them even question the legitimacy of the product. I’ve purchased other growth serums for ~$15-25 and those worked better, less irritation and more legit packaging. I should have gone that route instead of trying to save a few buck

I've had baby lashes MY ENTIRE LIFE. I got extensions and they literally cleared my lashing of all life. I started using serums religiously and tried 3 until I stumbled across this one. If you have lash combs comb it through it makes your lashes look amazing so you can avoid mascar while letting them get healthy. I've been using this product for about 2 months and I just ordered 2 back up bottles. Absolutely love it

I have been using Rapid Lash for over 15 years and thought I would try something else. I should have known better! This stuff did absolutely nothing and the brush was so big that it eventually started to separate into various hairs and was impossible to spread on the lid. Don't waste your money and buy apid Lash instead!

Although it didn't work as well as I'd hoped at first, this serum was gentle and easy to apply and the customer service can't be beat! Célor really wants every customer to be satisfied with their experience and I'll definitely be using their products in the future! Worth it for the price as well!

I’ve been using this product for two weeks and my lashes are already longer and thicker! I have used it on my eyebrows also and they have grown! It does not burn or make eyes red or itchy! This stuff is gold and such a great price... you also can receive a free second tube after receiving it!

Wow. I lost all my eyelashes because i unfortunately took off my eyelash extensions on my own (yeah, I know.) it not only my eyelashes but my eyebrows grow awesome in only like a month! I have no idea why the price went down dramatically because it was totally worth every penny.

I’ve only been using a little over a week so not much to report. I think my lashes may be a bit longer, but have not noticed any difference in thickness.  I like the clear tubing so you can see how much is left. It goes on my lash easily & I use 2x day. Will see.....

It took about one week before I started noticing a difference.  The  lash growth regenerates my lashes and they're thicker and longer. I'm still using product.  No stickiness or clumping. I apply the serum and then use a lash brush to thoroughly brush in. Thank you

Haven't been using this product long enough to tell how well it works but I like that this product is thick and doesn't run into my eyes and  sting.  I will be more likely to use the product and look forward to longer, thicker lashes and brows.

For the price it makes a big difference. I was using R&F lash boost that I received as a gift. I’m not going to spend that kind of money on it so this is working for me. I have not had any burning or skin irritation for this product.

Whenever I used this lash growth serum, my eyes became very itchy. I hoped it diminished and soon things will become normal, but it didn’t happen. I can’t continue using it anymore, and it was definitely not a pleasing experience!

Very pleased with the results of this product. After only a few weeks, I saw results with my lashes. I will definitely reorder. I would definitely recommend for people who need to apply TLC after wearing fake lashes.

I love the clear tube.  Easy to apply.  However, there is an insert in the box saying you can get free tube.  However, the website does not work.  I am now on my 2nd bottle and see new growth on my eyebrows.

Very simple to use , just two steps , top , bottom and you are done . I started seeing results within three days of using this product . This stuff is the real deal !!! Buy it , you won’t be disappointed .

I have dry eyes. Every winter I lose my eyelashes because of it. This year I bought Natural Eyelash Growth. My eyelashes did not fall out. Yippee! They are longer than they were and are healthy. Love this

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the serum actually works, producing longer and thicker lashes and brows.
Several reviewers say the product is gentle, not stinging, burning, or irritating their eyes.
A notable number of reviewers report no results or growth from using the product.
Some reviewers praise the company's responsive customer service and efforts to satisfy customers.
A few reviewers complain about the brush/applicator being too thin, too big, or falling apart.
